company_name: Changchun Changguang Yuanchen Microelectronic Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in semiconductor fabrication processes and offers a range of services for CMOS image sensor wafers.
summary: Changchun Changguang Yuanchen Microelectronic Technology Co., Ltd. (YCMEC) is an independent semiconductor fabrication facility that focuses on producing BSI, SOI, and specialized chip-level processes for 200mm and 300mm CMOS image sensor wafers. The company also provides customized semiconductor manufacturing and process design services tailored to various high-end applications.
capabilities: BSI CMOS image sensor wafer production
Optical coatings and thin films coating

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Changchun, Jilin Province, China, and serves a global customer base.
